notes.title: Update Preview: two major PVP new online, group peak sword optimization upgrade
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/9efbd201cd82b1a7d966e24a7a9f91dcd01077f1.jpg
Good afternoon, my Lord,
Today, we have the latest updates for you.
This edition of the update will continue to focus on PVP, and there are two new PVP features "Race the Stag" and "New Game" launched, continue to improve the competitive experience of the masters.

【 A New era of martial arts competition 】
In competitive play, the master can use the matching mechanism to challenge opponents who are on the same level as him.
Beating your opponent earns you points, and when you reach a certain point, you can challenge the "goal-keeping BOSS" of that level, and if successful, you can advance to the next level.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/7275b01fc8fa4bd0a69f6b785f93aec10ff3072a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/dbb9006e2dc1549f6057610a7cec04b823ceb6f9.jpg

【 New Suit Competition -- New dark horse to compete for the top 】
This is a new challenge only for a limited time. In this game, the master will match with other masters of the service, and at the end of the campaign, the master will be ranked according to the number of points earned.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/1dee3626b5646fb83592c873109b0c74d4d851cd.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/19352ccae2efabf826e2950a13b235c7457b0070.jpg

[Group Peak Analoquy Swords -- Updated refreshing battle]
After the upgrade, the master will challenge the opponent through the matching mechanism of the system. Each time, three opponents will be selected according to the criteria of balance attributes. The master can challenge according to his own strength.
- Added a cross-server combat mechanism, where the master will earn points for challenging cross-server opponents, redeemable in the bonus store.
There are also a variety of daily missions, which can be completed by the master in the suit's group peak sword challenge.
The title system is also getting a new update. The master can upgrade the title through points earned in cross-server battles and get more stat bonuses.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/2bab03c760dc02e6df28c5413e973618f0205aba.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/1822ed5fcece6e9525eb9951dce5445bf381a80c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/6869adddb1711eb540ae74bd8402fa2f5cbfdf23.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/b2b3c227ccd80cd0a96ac9ad296ec04be7f6ba76.png

More content needs to be experienced in the game, this trailer is over, let's see you next time.

notes.title: Update announcement on December 30
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/9efbd201cd82b1a7d966e24a7a9f91dcd01077f1.jpg
Updated on December 30, 2022 as follows:

1. The card collecting activity in the Central Plains will be open from January 1 to January 3 to receive free gift bags with the word "collection" every day, and there will be other gift bags for you to choose.


2. The newly added race towers in wandering the Jianghu - [Haoting Liquor Restaurant], [Famous Confucian Romance], [Roaring Dragon] and the comprehensive [Tower of the Sky] have different opening days each week. You can open it to wander the Jianghu for a detailed view.


3. A new ranking list of the Jianghu directory will be added in Wandering the Jianghu. The leader who wins the first prize will be specially displayed. You can enter the Wandering the Jianghu interface to view it in detail.


4. Open the [Restricted Exchange] activity. Leaders at level 20 and above on New Year's Day on January 1 can participate in it. They can replace SSS Xiake once. The specific replacement content can be viewed in the activity interface in detail at that time.


5. Choose to purchase the new quantity of the arena.


6. Fix the problem that some of the self selected effects and leader skills in the Central Plains are abnormal.


7. Optimize relevant display of dispatch interface, which can be opened for detailed view.


8. Optimize dialogue text, congratulations and other interface displays.


9. Update the display of Xiake's head and bust.


10. During the Spring Festival, the function of equipment package is coming, activating the power of four images; Control the relics, gather to explore the relics, get the relics secret treasure, and feel the power of the giant beasts; After that, there will be fishing and cooking. Please look forward to it!

notes.title: [new version preview] a new game will be launched soon
notes.notes:
Hello, leader~

It has been some time since the last update. With the encouragement of everyone, the program and planning heroes have carefully studied the feedback from the leaders in the previous version of the experience, and are determined to develop interesting and playable new functions. They have repeatedly adjusted every detail. Now the preliminary work has been completed, and more new games will be launched soon.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/8eee1a2182e0e8a8acad929f2efcf4819b25fe85.jpg
[new play - Qunfeng's discussion]

At the time of turbulence in the Jianghu, Wulin sects have sprung up one after another, and wantonly snatched rare treasures in the Jianghu in the struggle, causing the world to fall into a more chaotic situation. The people hope that a sect with superior strength and justice will emerge in the Wulin, leading the heroes and attacking the evil sects


After defeating the enemies in the sect, the player can obtain the Jianghu ranking of the sect, and can also obtain the prestige and tokens of continuous output. The higher the Jianghu ranking, the higher the output efficiency will be

[token] you can exchange various materials and props in the store within the function

[prestige] will permanently upgrade the player's "title" in the function

[title] will determine the content of props opened by the function store for players
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/653188279caf26341985f0fd6fbf6efc74aa4274.jpg
[optimization and adjustment - martial arts field]

The martial arts arena will be resident in the game, and the season system and rank level will be cancelled

The "daily mission", "Xinwu sword order" and "exchange shop" of the martial arts arena remain unchanged

A new PvP playing method will be launched soon. Please look forward to it. The martial arts arena will become a place for everyone to learn from each other

The leader can still obtain rewards by challenging opponents in the martial arts arena to complete tasks and exchange props in the mall

[advanced equipment - casting soul]

In the Jianghu, the most loyal partner is not others, but every piece of equipment we have. Through day-to-day running in and tempering, chivalrous men and equipment can learn from each other and complement each other's strengths. When they grow to a certain extent, they can endow the equipment with "tool soul"



Casting soul will increase the basic attributes of the Xiake: damage, life, external attack, internal attack, external defense, internal defense and speed

Various attributes are added to different parts. For example, weapons will increase damage, external attack and internal attack

The higher the casting level, the more corresponding attributes will be added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/9499189fcf78ed3ecdb84e46daed494fe2a07781.jpg
[new function - alchemy]

As the saying goes: people are wandering in the Jianghu, how can they not be stabbed. Of course, it is necessary to have some emergency pills when wandering in the Jianghu. However, there are many kinds of pills in the Jianghu, and the quality is also uneven. Therefore, we need to train ourselves to be able to refine pills. We can rest assured with our own pills



The corresponding [Dan Fang] and [medicinal materials] are required for alchemy

Each pill corresponds to different attributes. Add its corresponding attributes after being used by Xiake

Each Xiake has a use limit for each pill. When the use limit is reached, you can no longer use it

The pill has restrictions on the level of Xiake. You can't use the corresponding pill until you reach the corresponding level
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/8eee1a2182e0e8a8acad929f2efcf4819b25fe85.jpg
[fun play - Chuangwang ruins]

A mysterious sealed mechanism remains suddenly appeared overseas. There may be various treasures left in the mechanism relics, but there may also be many crises, unpredictable, lost and unable to extricate themselves. However, the leader can safely explore the island by carrying dice that are made with the secret technique of Tianji sect and can dispel clouds and unlock mechanisms. Each time you explore a layer of mechanism relics, you will get a little unsealing value. When the unsealing value reaches the peak, the relic will automatically unseal the next layer of seal, and the relic reward will be increased.



The leader advances by rolling dice in the dungeon

There will be three random events on each point: battle, award and punishment

You can unlock the challenge rewards of each level of the king's quest relic after you pass the level

There are various buffs, pill materials, soul casting materials and other reward items in the replica
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42311572/2c2fbf7a0111e4c603aae043c5b7483dfa42aedd.jpg
More content needs to be experienced in the game by the leaders. The preview of this issue is over. See you next time.

notes.title: 2022/6/24 Update Instructions
notes.notes:
1. Optimized the mastery activation of the Shenbing Pokédex. When activating the mastery level, you can freely choose to consume equipment or copper coins to activate

2. Adjust the dungeon mechanism, no longer deduct stamina when entering and exiting dungeons, the rewards obtained during the dungeon will be retained, and deduct stamina and issue dungeon rewards after clearing the dungeon

3. Optimize the completion process of the faction mission. After receiving the combat force mission, it will not jump to the martial arts to complete it, but will directly enter the battle in the faction interface.
After receiving the faction task of submitting equipment, a purchase button has been added to the task interface, and you can directly click to purchase the equipment

4. Adjust the upper limit of stamina to 2000 points, no longer restore stamina at 8:00, 12:00 and 18:00 every day, adjust to 0:00 a day and directly restore 1000 points

5. The Reward Center on the event page has added a cheat collection and recycling store. You can sell some cheats in exchange for [Martial Arts Original], and buy other items in the recycling store.

6. Optimized the scene performance of the fantasy trial

7. Adjusted the number of dispatches for the management relationship in Tongfu Inn to 3 times, and adjusted the number of official documents required for each dispatch of the manor guards in Shenhezhuang to 5

8. Adjust the content of the mall, add Treasure Map·1 and Treasure Map·2 to the Gold Ingot Mall, and cancel their purchases in the Silver Ingot Mall
